packages.rationale: GRADUATED 2026-08-13, two days ahead of the raise-by date. Measured coverage (95.4 statements / 88.4 branches / 89.4 functions / 97.1 lines) was already well clear of the 85/80/85/85 identity floor, so the floor was raised to the commitment without new tests — the named service-layer error paths (register-with-relay 4xx/5xx, bootstrap re-entry) had been covered by work landing after the 2026-06 snapshot was taken, and nobody re-measured. `branches` is held at 86, above its target of 80: a graduation target is a floor to reach, never a level to fall back to, and lowering a live threshold to match one would violate the never-lower-thresholds policy. Retained as a closed record rather than deleted so the commitment and its outcome stay auditable.

GRADUATED 2026-10-31, 30 days ahead of the 2026-11-30 raise-by date, by tests only (no source change). Before: 59.9/51.8/47.4/58.0 measured (floor 58/50/47/56). After: 96.9/94.6/100/97.0 measured; floor raised to 94/92/100/94 (the 2-point CI-variance margin of bf254dd88; functions held at 100 as near-full). The named lever (extract a runCli(argv) seam) was NOT needed: src/__tests__/helpers/run-main.ts reproduces the entry-point condition in-process (process.argv[1] = cli.ts, fresh module evaluation, stdout/stderr/exit intercepted at the process boundary only), so the real main() and both subcommand bodies run under v8 instrumentation against real signed fixtures. cli-main-in-process.test.ts asserts exit code, stream and named reason for every command path; cli-main-in-process.tampers.mjs breaks 11 CLI behaviours and each turns its test red. The 16 branches left uncovered were listed, not excluded: 4 defensive guards parseArgs makes unreachable (args.file/args.manifest undefined in the command bodies and main), 6 non-Error-throw arms of err instanceof Error, 2 in getPackageVersion (cache hit within one process; package.json without a version), and 4 fallbacks for fields the upstream verifiers always set (inner signerDid/reason/detail absent, outer content-artifact reason absent); plus the statement-only hexToBytes catch, which cannot throw. History: re-baselined 2026-08-22 (#568) when cli.ts entered measurement. Retained as a closed record so the commitment and its outcome stay auditable.
